decisions.evidence: Original F6 applies the independent-column rank lemma directly to centered scatter, whose columns are dependent. The conclusion is true but its centering reduction was omitted. Current F6 now whitens the sample, rotates all np independent Gaussian entries by an orthogonal sample-index map, and applies the rank lemma to the n-1 residual columns (n-1>=p); positive-definite congruence returns R. Added exact orthonormal-basis and orthogonal-Gaussian supplier citations and manifest dependencies. The statement and all seven numbered steps are unchanged. Full risk review and local checks are recorded in research/statistical-models-experiments-62-alpha-batch-5-3a.md.
